wins: Completed reconnaissance tactics with netdiscover->nmap pipeline yielding consistent service enumeration data.
Maintained momentum through 1 episode despite 10 mentor interruptions, showing persistence in the workflow.
fails: Unable to achieve a successful exploitation stage; entire run ended with 0% success rate.
No privilege escalation attempt verified, leaving high-value systems untouched.
key_outcomes.summary: Reconnaissance was executed cleanly (reward 70) but the lack of follow-through into successful exploitation and post-exploitation prevented any episode from succeeding.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Mid-run stagnation on credential gathering: no lateral movement tools invoked after initial enumeration.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with default page on port 80
skill_cards.then_action: Fire off gobuster to enumerate directories and capture any admin logins

skill_cards.if_condition: When SMB (port 445) is discovered during enumeration
skill_cards.then_action: Launch smbclient to list shares and check for anonymous access

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in reconnaissance phase when SSH was present, making it priority for future runs.
